Controls:
» Q - Call suit
» Q/E/R - Repulsors/Chest Repulsor
» T - Rockets 
» N - Eject
»» Pressing N when ejected and far away activates Suit Gantry call.
» K - Sentry mode
» M - Toggle mask
» F - Flight
» Left Ctrl - Flight Boost
» X - Remove suit
» Backspace - Helmet off
» G - Toggle Weapons (WM only)
» J - Infrared scan enemies (ranged)

» Voice commands »
Power on/Power up
Power down/Power off/Cut power/Kill power
Eject
Break
Send suit/Call suit
